attchmntText: Dcx Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Investor Presentation '.
voiceSummary: DCX Systems Limited has uploaded its investor presentation regarding the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The document is available on the company website at the specified web link. This disclosure is made pursuant to regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.

attchmntText: Dcx Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release'.
voiceSummary: DCX Systems Limited has uploaded the press release for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The document was dated November 11, 2026. The company submitted this information to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd pursuant to regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The press release is available on the company website at the specified weblink. Gurumurthy Hegde, Company Secretary, Legal and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: DCX Systems Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report confirms full utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offering. The IPO raised Rs. 400.00 crore. The company has no unutilized IPO proceeds. Consequently, DCX Systems is no longer required to submit Monitoring Agency Reports for the IPO. The report details revisions to fund allocation approved via postal ballot on May 6, 2024. Investment in subsidiary Raneal Advanced Systems Private Limited was reduced to Rs. 19.80 crore from Rs. 44.88 crore. General corporate purpose allocation increased to Rs. 83.23 crore. The company incurred a net loss of Rs. 8.66 crore in Q1FY27.

attchmntText: Dcx Systems Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: DCX Systems Limited approved its Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 11, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors NBS & Co. Total assets stood at 18,494.53 million rupees as of September 30, 2026, compared to 17,385.41 million rupees as of March 31, 2026. Revenue from operations was 1,382.25 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Profit before exceptional items and tax was 64.05 million rupees for the same quarter. The financial statements are available on the company website.
